name: International Business and Politics
summary: Half political science, half economics and mathematics, built around the question of how firms operate when regulation, trade policy and geopolitics keep moving. Roughly 40 per cent politics, 40 per cent economics and mathematics, with smaller blocks on trade and logistics and on organisation. Pick it if you would be equally happy reading a trade agreement and a balance sheet.

separateFrom.reason: A different subject: roughly 40 per cent politics beside economics and mathematics, where International Business is broad business economics. The names say how they differ; each is its own application.
